recommendedSlice.name: User-gesture camera ownership on ActiveRideMap
why: MAP-2C closed the largest geometry gap (disconnected pins). Remaining high-value asks (road corridor, ETA, live re-route) are authority/cost problems — not the smallest next slice.
Code evidence: GoogleMap allows gestures; Recenter is one-shot; no userOwnsCamera gate — auto-fit still fights users on first-fix and RIDE_STARTED.

Product direction explicitly requires: user-controlled pan/zoom; Recenter/Follow control; automatic camera must never continuously fight user gestures. Ownership is the missing functional prerequisite before follow/cinematic work.
Zero backend / RTDB / Routes / publisher / MAP-1 / MAP-2A / MAP-2C policy changes.
Does not implement Ora visual redesign.
exactInScope: ActiveRideMap: detect user camera interaction (onCameraMoveStarted or equivalent)
Set userOwnsCamera=true → suppress automatic _scheduleCameraFit animateCamera while owned
Recenter: clear ownership + one-shot policy fit (existing button semantics)
Preserve MAP-2B: when ownership=false, fitIdentity still drives refits (first appear / phase / anchors)
Preserve MAP-2C: guide endpoints still update every driver tick without camera calls
Unit/widget tests for ownership latch + MAP-2B animateCamera counts
Physical proof: pan then wait for first fix / phase flip without yank; Recenter restores policy framing
exactOutOfScope: Continuous follow mode / bearing chase / tilt
Google Routes / road polylines / estimate polyline reuse
Exposing distanceKm/estimatedDurationMin as passenger ETA-looking metrics
Marker interpolation / 3D / custom markers / map styling / Ora brand theme

openProductDecisions.question: Should first driver appearance auto-fit if user already panned before any fix?
openProductDecisions.recommendation: If ownership already true → do not auto-fit; Recenter still available. Prefer predictable ownership over silent override.

openProductDecisions.recommendation: Optional UX polish — not required for MAP-3 functional closure; keep IconButton if sufficient.
